body:
## Change

F1. Preserve surviving manual card order when undoing/redoing membership edits. Pass current deck lists into history transitions; deterministically restore missing copies and rebase membership snapshots for stable round trips.
F2. Preserve exact snapshot semantics for import, restore and explicit sort, per ADR-070 amendment to ADR-037. No persisted schema/export-name change.
F3. Narrow caller seam approved before implementation: only two undo/redo calls in DeckBuilderController changed. Existing callers/tests updated for current-list parameter.

## Validation

V1. Store-level add/remove/move → reorder → undo/redo failed before fix. Parent inspected algorithm, duplicate handling, rebased histories, call sites, and exact-sort/import preservation.
V2. Parent reran four history/sort/keyboard/controller files: 30 tests passed. Worker related history suite36, contracts87 passed. Temporary read-only asset fixture symlink used and removed.
V3. Typecheck: 0 errors/4 existing warnings; targeted lint/format and diff checks passed.

## Limits

L1. Required current-list parameter changes function signature; all production callers inspected and updated, no public export names added. Relative order of surviving copies is preserved; restored copies use deterministic target-snapshot positions.
L2. Controller/repository integration tested, not native browser drag/undo sequence. Full repository/browser suites not run locally; CI separate.
title: fix(decks): preserve manual order through membership history
